title: A builder cannot restore an old copy of a test file with git checkout <sha> -- <test path> or git restore --source=<sha> <test path>
why: That form can weaken a test with no Edit call, so no test guard sees it.
note: Incident: a builder in lane handoff-bash-redirect ran that form in its own worktree on Nov 7. Lane handoff-per-agent took it at the coordinator's ask (19:34 CST Nov 7); the PR goes to runner 8.
